name: Stygian-Tombolo
description: There is no surface, only an endless fall through banded clouds: amber belts, cream zones, and storms wide enough to swallow worlds. Lightning flickers between the layers like thoughts of a vast mind.

The air carries cold salt and iodine, and sound behaves strangely: footsteps crack loud, then die without echo. At night the temperature drops fast enough to hear the rock tick as it contracts. Sampler drones return with spore-forming microbes that survive direct exposure to open sky.
The descent was survivable; what came after was not. Salvage rights to escape pod debris field are contested by three claimants, two of them dead.
Opportunity here wears armor. Claims on helium-3 are staked, defended, and occasionally avenged, and the nearest law is a week's burn away.
